name: real-web-v2
cut: Pieces of web pages as they were on the day in "retrieved". "url" is the page, and "start" and "end" are a range of characters in the text of the page as the function visible of benchmark/rebuild.py gives it. "page" is the name under which a saved copy of the page is looked for.
ranges: [start, end, label]; start and end count Unicode code points, the end is exclusive
also: other readings of a text that the labelling guide accepts as well; a text is scored against the reading a system matches best
